what: per-coin, per-horizon verdict. A coin absent from a lane's list is served no direction on that lane at all -- not a weaker one.

gates.aboveOwnMajority: accuracy above the larger class of that coin's called rows
gates.bothDirectionsCalled: neither direction above 0.80 of its calls
gates.bootstrapExcludesZero: 95% day-blocked CI for (accuracy - majority) above zero
gates.walkForwardMajority: above its own block majority in 4 of 5 chronological blocks
gates.enoughCalledRows: at least 500 called rows on the test fold
